description.value:
Mingxi developed dozens of "creative Xianzhou dishes" for the Upside-Down Restaurant. Not all of them were hits. The most controversial by far has been the "Mung Bean Soda Sukiyaki." That said, it isn't exactly a commercial failure. Nobody actually likes the dish, but everyone who visits Astropolis would try it at least once.

"So weird, let me try a bite... *blech*... So weird, let me try another bite... *blech*... So weird, just one more bite... *blech*... So weird, one more bite... *blech*..."

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. Each creature first loses proficiency bonus hit points. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. For each affected creature, Strength increases by 1, maximum 20. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, immediately causes all allies to lose HP equal to 5% of their Max HP and increases their ATK by 40% for the next battle.
